notes: Tail case: all four units re-examined. Masks (white shirt, leftmost carved panel, garlanded statue, open door leaf) are correct edited regions and kept. Refs made precise; U2 replace payload made a genuine structural replacement; U4 payload changed because the door leaf already carries brass fittings.

spec.ref: the white short-sleeved shirt of the young man in front of the man in purple

units.ref_zh: 紫衣男子前方年轻男子的白色短袖衬衫
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将紫衣男子前方年轻男子的白色短袖衬衫的颜色改为深红色。
units.reason: 'white shirt at the lower left' also fits the older man's white shirt further left; ref now anchors on the purple-shirted man.

spec.ref: the leftmost pink carved floral panel on the shrine facade
spec.payload: a tall framed painting of a peacock

units.ref_zh: 神龛立面最左侧的粉色雕花板
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将神龛立面最左侧的粉色雕花板替换为一幅孔雀图案的竖长装框画。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一幅孔雀图案的竖长装框画。
units.reason: Three identical pink carved panels exist; mask is the leftmost. 'a painted ornament' was a vague style change; replaced by a structurally different object.

spec.ref: the garlanded black statue in the right shrine window

units.ref_zh: 右侧神龛窗内戴花环的黑色雕像
units.instruction_ref_zh: 移除右侧神龛窗内戴花环的黑色雕像。
units.reason: Two statues are visible (central altar idol and right window statue); ref made specific.

spec.ref: the open carved wooden door leaf in the central doorway
spec.payload: a garland of orange marigold flowers

units.ref_zh: 中央门洞内敞开的雕花木门扇
units.instruction_ref_zh: 给中央门洞内敞开的雕花木门扇挂上一串橙色万寿菊花环。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域挂上一串橙色万寿菊花环。
units.reason: The door leaf already has brass handle-like fittings, so adding a brass handle is near-redundant; a marigold garland is natural in this temple.
